# Source: Komurasaki of the Miuraya and Shirai Gompachi (Miuraya Komurasaki, Shirai Gompachi)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Komurasaki of the Miuraya and Shirai Gompachi (Miuraya Komurasaki, Shirai Gompachi)
- **Artist / culture:** Kitagawa Utamaro 喜多川 歌麿 Japanese, c.1753-1806
- **Date:** c. 1800
- **Style:** Japanese (culture or style)
- **Classification:** woodblock print
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 7624
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/7624
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/66c4dafb-2f53-f5ac-b676-32cafbe5b6bd/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Japanese Woodblock

## Extracted source palette

`#E8D8A8, #C8B888, #282818, #A89878, #484838, #887858, #686848, #F8F8E8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#15150C`
- `surface`: `#303028`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#E8D8A8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#282818`
- `surface_variant`: `#303028`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#55554E`
- `error`: `#E8D8A8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.26:1`, surface `12.51:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.51:1`
- Control contrast: `13.79:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
